title: Applied Mathematics in Ferroelectricity and Piezoelectricity
summary: This textbook, Applied Mathematics in Ferroelectricity and Piezoelectricity, was authored to provide the reader with a solid mathematical background for studying “ferroelectricity and piezoelectricity” as a supplemental reference to my three course books, Ferroelectric Devices 2nd Edition (2010), Micromechatronics 2nd Edition (2019), and FEM and Micromechatronics with ATILA Software (2008), all published from CRC Press. “Physics” prefers “simplicity”, converting a complicated phenomenon expressed by a function.
